text:
From the head of Śaiva, from the head of Paśupati, from the earth-bearer,
from the deep, from the high, from the earth, from the lord of the earth, and from the ocean of waters,
downward, downward, to the place of Gaṅgā, having descended a little,
or, for those who have lost discernment, becomes the fall into the hundred-mouthed (hell).
